title: Health section in Angular
goal: Health (doctor run, problems, health metrics, model-down and degraded banners, updater status) renders in the workspace with the same behaviour as live.js
acceptance: Doctor run, its result and chat line, /api/health/metrics rows, the degraded banner and updater status (/api/update/status, dismiss, apply) match live.js for the same API data
A test across the API handler and the component checks the rows; the old Health panel links to the new one
privacy: Neutral invented sorties, devices and names only; tokens and pairing codes never in tests or logs.
escalation: A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: reuses doctor-view; ports healthRowHtml, healthMetricRows, doctorRunHtml and the updater rows. Not a measurement.
